summary: Gate of supervision: 2 questions on r188 and r189.
questions: r189: no line starts a round of the kind `integrate` for a glossary-proposal (r141, r149, r150 do so only for a capability-proposal), so the trigger of r189 has no line leading to it. Line (added): [r189] **When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the terms of a glossary-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the terms of the glossary-proposal that the round's change list does not name. Reading A (recommended): r189 stands as drafted. Reading B: also add [r190] **When** a round of the kind `apply` gives in its result an answer that the drafts it applied do not hold for a glossary-proposal, `work run` shall start a new round of the kind `integrate` for the glossary-proposal. Reading C: defer r189 to Not yet.

r189, what "keep" means for terms. Line (added): [r189] as above. Reading A (recommended): the terms stay in what `work run` writes for the glossary-proposal under r171, the line as drafted. Reading B: the person meant something else by keeping a term; the line is redrafted. (r188, the capability-proposal's requirement ids, is added as the person's answers gave it: [r188] **When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the lines of a capability-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the requirement ids of the proposal that the round's change list does not name.)
